This report installs any missing packages, records the R and package versions
the analysis is run with, and probes the package functions whose interface
differs between versions. The later reports are adapted to what these probes show.

# 1. Packages

```{r install}
pkgs <- c("readxl", "psych", "lavaan", "semTools", "eRm", "mirt", "difR", "ltm",
          "BifactorIndicesCalculator", "GPArotation", "pbivnorm", "ggplot2", "gridExtra",
          "rmarkdown", "knitr")
miss <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(miss)) install.packages(miss, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
cat("Installed during this run:", if (length(miss)) paste(miss, collapse = ", ") else "none", "\n")
```

```{r setup}
setup_file <- c("R/00_setup.R", "../R/00_setup.R")
source(setup_file[file.exists(setup_file)][1])
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = PROJ)
cat("Project root:", PROJ, "\n")
```

# 2. R and package versions

```{r versions}
cat(R.version.string, "\n", R.version$platform, "\n", sep = "")
data.frame(package = pkgs,
           version = vapply(pkgs, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)), ""),
           row.names = NULL)
```

# 3. Argument names of version-sensitive functions

```{r args}
probe <- function(label, expr) {
  cat("\n>>", label, "\n")
  print(tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) paste("ERROR:", conditionMessage(e))))
}
probe("semTools::compRelSEM",    names(formals(semTools::compRelSEM)))
probe("semTools::measEq.syntax", names(formals(semTools::measEq.syntax)))
probe("BifactorIndicesCalculator::bifactorIndices",
      names(formals(BifactorIndicesCalculator::bifactorIndices)))
probe("difR::difMH",       names(formals(difR::difMH)))
probe("difR::difLogistic", names(formals(difR::difLogistic)))
probe("difR::difLord",     names(formals(difR::difLord)))
```

# 4. Live probes on a small part of the real data

These only show the *structure* of each package's output; the numbers are not
used anywhere.

```{r probes}
d <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(file.path(DATA, "DASS.xlsx"), na = "#NULL!"))
d <- d[complete.cases(d[ITEMS]), ITEMS]
d[] <- lapply(d, as.numeric)
b6 <- as.matrix((d[, 1:6] >= 1) * 1)

probe("eRm: names(RM(.))", names(eRm::RM(b6)))
probe("eRm: names(itemfit(person.parameter(RM(.))))",
      names(eRm::itemfit(eRm::person.parameter(eRm::RM(b6)))))
probe("mirt: extract.mirt(., 'nest') and 'logLik'", {
  m <- mirt::mirt(as.data.frame(b6), 1, "2PL", verbose = FALSE)
  c(nest = mirt::extract.mirt(m, "nest"), logLik = mirt::extract.mirt(m, "logLik"))
})
probe("difR: names(difMH(.))", {
  g <- rep(0:1, length.out = nrow(b6))
  names(difR::difMH(Data = b6, group = g, focal.name = 1))
})
```

```{r bifactor-probe}
bf <- 'G  =~ dass3 + dass5 + dass10 + dass2 + dass4 + dass7
       S1 =~ dass3 + dass5 + dass10
       S2 =~ dass2 + dass4 + dass7'
fit_bf <- tryCatch(
  lavaan::cfa(bf, data = d, std.lv = TRUE, orthogonal = TRUE, estimator = "WLSMV",
              ordered = c("dass3", "dass5", "dass10", "dass2", "dass4", "dass7")),
  error = function(e) e)
probe("small bifactor converged?",
      if (inherits(fit_bf, "error")) conditionMessage(fit_bf) else lavaan::lavInspect(fit_bf, "converged"))
probe("str(BifactorIndicesCalculator::bifactorIndices(fit))",
      str(BifactorIndicesCalculator::bifactorIndices(fit_bf)))
probe("semTools::compRelSEM(fit)", semTools::compRelSEM(fit_bf))
probe("lavPredict on ordered data (EBM)", dim(lavaan::lavPredict(fit_bf, method = "EBM")))
```
